name: Can I switch from a flexible listing agreement to an exclusive agreement?

mainEntity.name: Can I switch from a flexible listing agreement to an exclusive agreement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is generally possible to switch from a flexible listing agreement to an exclusive agreement, provided both you and the real estate agent agree to the change. This often involves terminating the initial flexible agreement and then entering into a new, exclusive contract. When working with Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution, we can discuss the process and necessary paperwork for such a transition, ensuring a smooth adjustment to your selling strategy if market conditions or your preferences evolve during the selling period.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can typically switch listing agreement types if both you and your agent agree and sign new terms.
